sources.title: 德国法院裁定AI音乐生成器Suno侵犯版权，驳回合理使用抗辩 / German court rules AI music generator Suno violated copyrights， rejects fair use defense
sources.title_zh: 德国法院裁定AI音乐生成器Suno侵犯版权，驳回合理使用抗辩
sources.title_en: German court rules AI music generator Suno violated copyrights， rejects fair use defense
sources.title_original: German court rules AI music generator Suno violated copyrights， rejects fair use defense
sources.summary: 慕尼黑法院裁定，AI音乐生成器Suno在训练过程及输出结果中均侵犯版权，并驳回其合理使用抗辩。法院认定Suno 3.5和4版本模型可复现六首知名歌曲的原创元素，构成"记忆化"侵权，且责任归于Suno而非用户。该判决还认定美国版权法下的合理使用不适用于此案，目前尚未最终生效。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 慕尼黑法院裁定AI音乐生成器Suno在训练与输出环节均侵权，认定六首歌曲可复制存储于其模型中，并同时驳回德国文本数据挖掘例外与美国合理使用抗辩。

items.title: OpenAI Astra 以约2000美元证明10项数学难题 / ten significant advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science. solved using an internal …

sources.title: OpenAI Astra 以约2000美元证明10项数学难题 / ten significant advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science. solved using an internal …
sources.title_zh: OpenAI Astra 以约2000美元证明10项数学难题
sources.title_en: ten significant advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science. solved using an internal …
sources.title_original: ten significant advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science. solved using an internal …
sources.summary: OpenAI 用下一代模型 Astra 内部版解决了数学与理论计算机科学领域的10项重大进展，总成本约2000美元（按 Sol API 价格计算）。Astra 证明了非 sofic 群的存在，并推翻 Connes 刚性猜想，成果涵盖 von Neumann 代数、高维球堆积、电路复杂度等。OpenAI 已发布全部10项证明，附 Lean 证书与 CoT 逐步推导。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Astra内部模型以约2000美元成本解决了数学与理论计算机科学领域的十项重大进展，展示出惊人推理能力与性价比，值得关注Sol API背后的技术突破。

FWIW, bonds are no longer a hedge against equity unless they’re based against private equity and private equity is both more expensive and more performant than ever.
reply

reply
What will AI do when those rules, which it's trained on their repetition so much, don't apply anymore? ~8% annual stock gains for the next 40 years may n
sources.recommend_reason_zh: AI理财建议虽正确却过于通用：无非是“储蓄、投资指数基金、45岁后降低股票仓位”，但文章质疑未来40年8%年化收益和80/20股债比还能否成立，也揭示当用户没钱可存时，AI只会建议“多赚钱”。

primary_item.title: 只要问对问题，AI理财建议出奇地好用 / AI financial advice is surprisingly good if you ask the right questions
primary_item.title_zh: 只要问对问题，AI理财建议出奇地好用
primary_item.title_en: AI financial advice is surprisingly good if you ask the right questions
primary_item.title_original: AI financial advice is surprisingly good if you ask the right questions
primary_item.summary:
FWIW, bonds are no longer a hedge against equity unless they’re based against private equity and private equity is both more expensive and more performant than ever.
reply
By comparison, financial advice is pretty simple, and there is a universally agreed-upon approach that most people should follow to maximize long-term financial health.
reply
What will AI do when those rules, which it's trained on their repetition so much, don't apply anymore? ~8% annual stock gains for the next 40 years may n
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: AI理财建议虽正确却过于通用：无非是“储蓄、投资指数基金、45岁后降低股票仓位”，但文章质疑未来40年8%年化收益和80/20股债比还能否成立，也揭示当用户没钱可存时，AI只会建议“多赚钱”。

items.persona_review: 理财建议看提问技巧，但没给具体工具或方案，动手价值有限。
